==Description==
'''Jack O' Bot''' appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as the final boss of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. It had a high amount of health and three abilities. Despite its very slow speed and the huge length of the map, it was very difficult to defeat due to a combination of its abilities and the [[enemies]] it spawned.

It had three abilities:
#The first ability it could perform was its ''Jack O' Bombs'' attack. With this attack, '''Jack O' Bot''' shot three explosive pumpkins at three random towers. On impact, the pumpkins would explode, and all towers within the explosion radius would be set on fire (stunning them). This disabled them from attacking for a long period of time.
#Its second ability was the ''Jack O' Minigun''. With this attack, '''Jack O' Bot''' shot lasers at nearby towers, doing so in a sweeping fashion, stunning all towers hit for a period of time.
#Its third, and final, ability was ''Hallowed Laugh''. This ability could spawn [[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]]s, [[Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)|Mummies]], [[Frankenstein (Nightmare Carnival)|Frankenstein]]s, [[Ghost (Nightmare Carnival)|Ghosts]], [[Witch (Nightmare Carnival)|Witches]], [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bats]], [[Swamp Thing]]s, [[Demon (Nightmare Carnival)|Demon]]s, [[Scarecrow (Nightmare Carnival)|Scarecrow]]s, [[Strong Mummy|Strong Mummies]] and [[Clown (Nightmare Carnival)|Clown]]s in front of the '''Jack O' Bot'''.

==Appearance==
'''Jack O' Bot''' was a giant pumpkin robot armed with a laser machine gun and an arm cannon. It had a pumpkin head (similar to {{RLinkC|17450053|Sinister P}}), pumpkins on its shoulders and a fleshed-out torso, but everything else appeared to be mechanical. It had a skull below its torso, and a metal pad on its chest. It was extremely tall due to its mechanical legs.

==Strategy==
*Use towers with high DPS and decent range against this boss. Towers such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] are strongly recommended against this boss.
**Once '''Jack O' Bot''' goes out of range of these towers, relocate them to further weaken the boss.
**[[Ranger|Outlaws]] and even [[Sentry|Sentries]], when set to ''Strongest'', can be very effective at dealing damage to '''Jack O' Bot'''.
*[[Rocketeer]]s are very useful at dealing with the [[enemies]] '''Jack O' Bot''' spawns because these enemies normally spawn in hordes.
*The [[Military Base]] can also deal lots of damage to '''Jack O' Bot''' (and the enemies it spawns) when upgraded to Level 5.
*[[Commander]]s are highly recommended since they can boost the firerate of towers.
*Because '''Jack O' Bot''' stuns towers with its ''Jack O' Minigun'' and ''Jack O' Bombs'' abilities, the [[Medic]]'s ability can be very useful in cleansing your towers from '''Jack O' Bot's''' stun, provided it is not stunned itself.
*The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Freezer]] (including the ''Ice Age'' ability) cannot slow down '''Jack O' Bot''', but they can still be useful in slowing down the enemies that '''Jack O' Bot''' spawns.
*Do not underestimate the enemies '''Jack O' Bot''' spawns, especially the [[Swamp Thing]] and [[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]], as their high health can be extremely detrimental.
**Place towers near the end of the map to prevent these enemies reaching the end. [[Freezer]]s are recommended to delay the [[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]].
*If you can, try not to cluster towers close together as they will all get stunned when attacked with '''Jack O' Bot''''s ''Jack O' Bombs'' and ''Jack O' Minigun'' abilities.

==Trivia==
*'''Jack O' Bot's''' name is a combination of the words "jack o' lantern" and "robot".
*'''Jack O' Bot''' was likely based on the [[w:c:r2da:Pumpkinator|Pumpkinator]] boss from ''R2DA'' which, in turn, was based on the [[w:c:fairlyoddparents:Pumpkinator|Pumpkinator]] from ''Fairly Odd Parents''.
**However, its name was based on the [[w:c:fairlyoddparents:Jack-O-Bots|Jack-O-Bots]] from ''Fairly Odd Parents''.
*A similar enemy to '''Jack O' Bot''' can be seen in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]], the [[Mechanical Rot (Legacy)|Mechanical Rot]].
**The [[Mechanical Rot (Legacy)|Mechanical Rot]] may be a reincarnation or rebuilt version of '''Jack O' Bot''', hence its name.
*'''Jack O' Bot''' was the second enemy to use R15 animations, after the [[Gold Titan]].
*In [[The Haunted Past|Act II]] of the [[Lunar Overture Event]], '''Jack O' Bot''' is the final boss, its name changed to [[Jack-o-Bot]].
**It is confirmed in this event that '''Jack O' Bot''' was actually sent by [[The Umbra]] to fight the players.
